text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Curren Chan asks me to
accompany her
on a photo shoot. I wait
a bit at the spot where
we agreed to
meet, until...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm here!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Sorry for making you wait!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're so patient! Thanks! ♪ Okay, let's
get
going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I point the camera at Curren Chan, who's
beaming
from ear to ear, cute as ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking back...

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. I'm here to challenge you. I
might not
be anywhere near as popular
as you right now,
but I swear I'll get
more likes than you one day!

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait. I'll beat you using the one
thing I
have that you don't—womanly
charm.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just like that. Focus your mind right
down to your
fingertips. Then
concentrate on your ears and tail.
Try
not to make any unnecessary
movements.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gee willikers! You look splend'd, Curren!
Why,
you're so lov'ly, I've fallen head
ov'r heels for ya!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now I've got womanly charm and the
means to
show it off! I knew City was the
right person to
ask! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure she's been doing her best
to show
everyone her womanly charm,
but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... Does it look that way to you?
choice_data_list: Did you give up on "grown-up charm"?
Did you give up on "grown-up charm"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I don't think she looks like she's
given up...
I find myself struggling to
answer when put on the
spot...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ...Hey. Whatever you do, don't
take your
eyes off me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as Curren Chan asks, I keep my eyes
trained
on her and keep snapping
photos. While doing
so, in a brief and
unexpected lapse between
smiles, I
catch a faraway look in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen an expression like that
on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes, which had been focused on
the lens,
have been seemingly drawn
away by some other
force. I find myself
about to say something to her,
when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan looks back in my direction
and
flashes me a smirk.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. What's wrong? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me—is your heart aflutter from
seeing
me in a slightly different light?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Really? You didn't feel anything?
Nothing at all?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Oh, my poor heart...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, I know. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know, I thought of something. If I
changed
everything about myself... I
wouldn't be me
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
My womanly charm and my cuteness
come as a
pair. I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If people can see my womanly charm
within my
usual cuteness, that's good
enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Do you get what I mean? ...Trainer? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds as if she's testing me, but her
smile is
innocent. I can only manage a
nod in reply.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I find out that the
photos we
took already have quite a
number of likes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, but the college girl
apparently sent
her a DM saying, "I
noticed that new charm of
yours! But I'm
still gonna beat you!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wish you'd be a little clearer... Or do
you mean
that I still have a ways to go?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Looking good. I'd say you're just about
there.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, City! Were you... watching me,
by any
chance?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I just happened to have a shoot nearby.
In any
case, it looks like you've found
your womanly
charm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, so you picked up on it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Basically, Curren Chan is never going to
be about
womanly charm alone.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Cuteness is a part of who she is, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep! ♪ Without that, I wouldn't be me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But she's not only cute. Sometimes, a brief glimpse of an expression or a gesture... something she doesn't usually show, shines through.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: As far as Curren Chan is concerned, that is her womanly charm. ...Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Right on the money! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm still getting the hang of it right now,
but I'm
going to polish my womanly
charm little by little
every day from now
on. You know why?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I want everyone to be even more
head
over heels for me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan says this with her trademark

adorable smile.
